notes: Buyer's guide ramp item 5 (P16). Best-for format by job (issue, compare, outsource, answer the GC's tool), not a score. Vendor facts from each vendor's own page checked Nov 24, 2026 (Applied CSR24 help, Vertafore AgencyOne release Apr 16 2026, Certificial agents page, ReSource Pro Certs Center, Billy FAQ, TrustLayer broker article). Certificial's page says free for agents and also lists $249/$639 tiers; the post says both. Billy FAQ has unfinished bracketed notes in some answers; only clean answers cited. The Big I (independentagent.com) Ask-an-Expert post gives the agent-side caution about platforms that want policy data instead of a COI. The one thing no competing page has: the point that most deficiency notices are coverage problems (an endorsement or a limit), not certificate problems, so the fastest tools are the ones that show the broker the exact requirement.
